readerCopy.body: Attention can feel harsher than it is when visibility touches an old memory of being judged, embarrassed, or singled out. When the Sun squares Chiron, identity and sensitivity create friction, making praise, criticism, presentation, leadership, or being seen carry an earlier fear into the present. If attention feels harsher than the actual feedback, you may notice that the old audience has quietly joined the current one. The reaction can contain useful information without proving that the earlier outcome is repeating.
